answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a $30 entry tax, burned at registration. Each dawn a public beacon sets the rate and audits 5% of accounts; a fake caught twice loses its deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 in tax plus $5,000 in deposits, far above the $3,000 epoch pool share, so bulk forgery loses money. An honest agent pays $30 once and keeps its full share. Identities active 20 epochs become relics, exempt from further tax.
